title: Live feature walk for you: terminals, agent feed, notepad, mail cards, allow, keys (isolated perches 48030/48031)
what:
Runs demo_plan part B:
- isolated perches under env -i with temp HOME and temp Aoide roots, a mock-only door and the probe tool
- the ssh probe is X0's closed-port line. Optionally, if /usr/sbin/sshd exists, a throwaway sshd on 127.0.0.1:48039 with a temp host key, `AuthorizedKeysFile none` and the same client flags, so you see a real handshake end in 'Permission denied'.
- you type in the terminals and drive the page
- a two-node mail attempt between two temp Aoide roots on loopback, time-boxed to 15 min, with a precise report if pairing two local roots is not possible
- teardown on your word
live_check:
Screenshots of each step. After teardown:
- ports 48030, 48031, 48039, 48710 and 48711 are free
- the 47820 perch pid is unchanged
- ~/.aoide mtimes are unchanged (unless D12 = a for the mesh view)
- the ~/.config/eidolon and ~/Minerva manifests are identical
risk: Pairing two local roots may need steps aoide does not offer on loopback. The mail step then proves self delivery only.
